problem_statement: Engineers need a reusable, understandable way to evaluate a policy against model behavior.
hypothesis: Reviewed policy prompts and adaptive conversations can reveal violations and unnecessary refusals across supported model generations.
customer_scenario: An engineer learns ASSERT with editable synthetic customer-support policies and a verified three-model comparison on one frozen 14-case suite.
data_requirements: Synthetic policy and cases only; defaults generate 8 prompts and 4 adaptive scenarios plus two fresh editable starter prompts per suite. Review before target inference.
security_notes: Keyless native Entra authentication using Azure CLI identity; local auth disabled in Bicep. No keys or tokens in demo files or notebook outputs. Learning lab, not production certification.
setup_time_estimate: 20-40 minutes after Azure access, policy, and model quota are confirmed
